/*selectSellerMpClCmsCmplReqStateList*/ SELECT A.BUYER ,A.AGENT ,A.REQ_NO ,A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,D.IMGFILE_DIR ,D.IMGFILE_NAME ,(SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME_LOC ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID =B.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USR.PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID =B.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_TEL ,B.REVISION ,DECODE(B.STATUS,'S','보완요청','C','제출완료','O','제출완료') AS STATUS_NM ,D.DESCRIPTION_LOC ,D.SPECIFICATION ,D.MAKER_CODE ,D.MAKER_NAME ,D.ORIGIN_CODE ,(SELECT COD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'M001' AND COD.CODE = D.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME ,D.UNIT_MEASURE ,B.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS S_DESCRIPTION_LOC ,B.SPECIFICATION AS S_SPECIFICATION ,B.MAKER_CODE AS S_MAKER_CODE ,B.MAKER_NAME AS S_MAKER_NAME ,B.ORIGIN_CODE AS S_ORIGIN_CODE ,(SELECT COD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'M001' AND COD.CODE = B.ORIGIN_CODE) AS S_ORIGIN_NAME ,B.UNIT_MEASURE AS S_UNIT_MEASURE ,B.IMGFILE_DIR AS S_IMGFILE_DIR ,B.IMGFILE_NAME AS S_IMGFILE_NAME ,A.ATOS_REMARK ,B.STOA_REMARK ,A.REJECT_REMARK ,B.ADD_DATE AS REQ_ADD_DATE ,D.MAKER_PART_NO ,B.MAKER_PART_NO AS S_MAKER_PART_NO FROM KEPCMSHD A, KEPCMSDT B, ICOMCMPY C, ICOMBYIT D WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.REQ_NO = B.REQ_NO AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE AND C.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = D.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = D.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND B.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_buyer_item_no}||'%'
AND D.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_description}||'%'
AND D.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_specification}||'%'
AND B.STATUS = 'S'
AND B.STATUS IN ('C','O')
ORDER BY B.ADD_DATE
